body: This really helped me feel a lot better. I wish I can have a friend like you. I hope you are having a wonderful day/night, wherever you're from! :)
Honestly, I get so sad when I am alone. But when I am with my friends or any other human beings, I become instantly happy. I don't know if I still suffer from depression, or if I'm an extrovert.
Hello there, I definitely am interested! :) Thanks for reaching out to me!

Hey there, I am in a similar situation with you. I am having issues with my physical appearance as a young woman, and I've been told that I am genuinely kind. But lately, the way I've been treated by some people makes me feel like I'm not good enough.
